bagPolicy.summary: Bags cannot exceed 12" x 6" x 12". Larger bags must be checked at the Guest Services booth.
allowed: One factory sealed plastic water bottle
prohibited: Professional cameras (detachable lenses or lenses over 2")
bagPolicy.note: Bags over the size limit are checked at the Guest Services booth. Strollers are checked and held at Guest Services. Cameras are subject to artist approval.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; recommends or requires advance purchase where offered.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use Lot C at Vermont Avenue and Commonwealth for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Enter from Vermont Avenue.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The Greek Theatre is cash-free and accepts only debit and credit cards. Outside food and beverages aren't allowed, except one factory-sealed plastic water bottle per person. You can bring an empty plastic or Nalgene reusable bottle, but no metal bottles.

accessibility.summary: At least 41 wheelchair and semi-ambulatory tickets are available throughout the theatre, and wheelchair locations have no fixed chair. The accessible drop-off area is in front of the Box Office. Only trained service animals are allowed, and they must be harnessed, leashed, or tethered. Call the Box Office at 323-606-8106 for help.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed at any event.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information and lists hours of 12pm-6pm; will call is addressed on the linked page.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific gate or door-time policy.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
